issuer: Government of Guinea-Bissau / African Development Bank
title: Recruitment of a Training Institution for Capacity Building of 30 SME Support Organisations in Guinea-Bissau – Youth and Women Entrepreneurship and SME Development – Lusophone Compact Phase I
deadline_evidence: Deadline surfaced as 30 September 2026 by current procurement index; official AfDB notice was checked but the deadline was not exposed in the indexed AfDB page text. Reconfirm from the downloadable EOI before submission.
arrangement: Institutional consulting / training and capacity building
source_context: Original AfDB procurement notice published 16 September 2026. AfDB states that the Government of Guinea-Bissau is recruiting a training institution to strengthen the capacity of 30 SME support organisations under the Youth and Women Entrepreneurship and SME Development – Lusophone Compact Phase I project. The underlying AfDB project appraisal states that the relevant subcomponent is intended to create/train 30 business-support organisations to improve the quality of business development support services.
opportunity_summary: AfDB-financed institutional assignment to strengthen 30 SME/business-support organisations in Guinea-Bissau. The thematic core—BDS quality, entrepreneurship support, institutional capacity building, training/ToT and SME ecosystem strengthening—is exceptionally close to Tuku-Tuku's operating domain. Actual bid eligibility remains conditional pending the full EOI's corporate-experience, language, geography and specialist thresholds.
fit_summary: Exceptional thematic alignment with Tuku-Tuku's MSME/BDS, entrepreneurship, curriculum/training, ToT and support-provider strengthening capabilities. A Lusophone/local consortium structure is likely the strongest commercial posture because Tuku-Tuku's verified evidence does not establish Portuguese capability or Guinea-Bissau delivery history.
decision_rationale: Advance to EOI qualification immediately, but do not bid as a standalone firm until the original downloadable EOI is checked for language, corporate-reference, turnover, local-registration, key-expert and geographic requirements. Consortium Bid is the prudent posture because local/Lusophone capacity is currently an evidence gap.
